selector.rationale: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma, and PET-CT showed multiple hypermetabolic masses in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest, with core-needle biopsy revealing poorly differentiated epithelioid cells

rejected.label: Disseminated peritoneal leiomyomatosis
rejected.why: No evidence of leiomyomatosis in the pathology re-review of the hysterectomy and oophorectomy specimens

rejected.label: Leiomyomatosis peritonealis disseminata
rejected.why: Similar to disseminated peritoneal leiomyomatosis, no evidence of leiomyomatosis in the pathology re-review

rejected.label: Endometriosis
rejected.why: While superficial pelvic endometriosis was noted and cauterized during surgery, the current presentation is more consistent with a malignant process
